allow_large: Owner approved fewer repeated lookups (2026-10-06): it touches command-line internals to look git facts up once per command, keeping every command, option and help text unchanged
done_when: Within one forge command the default branch, landed ref and git common folder are looked up once, and close reads the commits it needs with one git log call; behaviour is unchanged; a command test counts git calls in one close and shows each of those lookups happens once; the sdk_data test fixture finds the real uv even when a stub uv is on PATH; new and earlier-adopted client repos get it, with a command test for each

findings.body: With `log.showSignature=true` and a signed commit first in the batch, Git prints signature diagnostics before the NUL-delimited record ([Git documentation](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-log), [output ordering](https://github.com/git/git/blob/v2.51.0/log-tree.c#L793-L829)). The parser then treats that preamble as a record and raises `ValueError` at line 166, so close crashes before review. The previous message readers searched individual lines and did not require every output segment to contain a SHA and message. Pass `--no-show-signature` when reading this machine-readable batch.
findings.title: [P2] Disable signature output in the machine-readable log

findings.body: The replacement log enables rename detection by default, unlike the previous plumbing command ([Git configuration](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-config#Documentation/git-config.txt-diffrenames)). For a worker commit moving `app.py` to `plans/archived.py`, `--name-only` reports only the destination. `commit_paragraph` at `src/forge/review.py:372` therefore classifies the commit as bookkeeping and copies an older commit's proof and functional check, ignoring the newest worker message. This affects both paragraph readers. Add `--no-renames` so classification still sees the deleted product path.
findings.title: [P2] Disable rename detection when identifying bookkeeping commits

why: One forge close looks up the same git facts again and again (default branch 74 times, landed ref 24, git common folder 13) and reads each commit message with its own git calls; and a shared test fixture breaks when another test has put a stub uv on PATH
